  1477	## Failures and how to do differently
  1478	
  1479	- symptom: a merge/review run looks successful because canonical finals exist -> cause: the finals can still be deterministic or warning-bearing -> fix: inspect `papers/<paper_id>/work/review/quality_feedback.json` and the provenance fields before calling the lane done [Task 1][Task 2]
  1480	- symptom: inbox says strict review but the helper fast path still seems tempting -> cause: older deterministic shortcuts are faster but can violate local lane instructions -> fix: obey the inbox override, audit original paper-local source materials directly, and use the wrapper/helper only for safe writes and mailbox operations [Task 1]
  1986	
  1987	- symptom: bootstrap returns `claim_conflict` for task 4 -> cause: ownership was already claimed even though rerun work still needed to happen -> fix: read mailbox/inbox, use packet inspection to confirm scope, then continue the source-reviewed rerun inside the assigned directories instead of retrying claims blindly [Task 1][Task 4]
  1988	- symptom: existing final artifacts look complete but review still blocks acceptance -> cause: `quality_feedback.json` marks them as deterministic/fallback or still carries stale deterministic-review findings -> fix: rebuild from accepted upstream evidence plus `paper.xml`/tables/source text, and treat the quality-feedback gate as authoritative until it is explicitly cleared [Task 1][Task 6]
  1989	- symptom: the team summary shows intake/body/supp tasks complete, so it feels safe to call the paper done -> cause: task-family progress was conflated with task-4 acceptance, and the final artifacts still carried deterministic-generated findings -> fix: inspect the merge/review gate separately and keep the paper in active/blocker state until task 4 is explicitly source-reviewed and accepted [Task 7]
